name: 狂野牌组 Deck of Wild Cards (BMT)

description.value:
奇物，极珍稀

这副厚重的羊皮纸卡牌充满了混沌元素的魔力。

只有在随机抽取卡牌的情况下（可以用一套现实世界的牌组模拟这套牌组），这副牌的魔力才能发挥作用。花费一个动作，你可以从这副卡牌中随机抽取一张，并投掷它以进行远程法术攻击，使用敏捷进行攻击检定。该卡牌具有30尺的射程。命中时，它造成[[/damage 1d4 type=slashing]]伤害，并施加一个由花色决定的魔法效果，详见狂野牌组表。不论是否命中，攻击后该卡牌会立即回到牌组中。

狂野牌组
[[/r d4]]花色效果
1♣ (草花)这张卡牌会吐出一股火焰喷涌。目标及其周围5尺范围内的每个生物必须进行一次[[/save ability=dex dc=15]]豁免，豁免失败将受到[[/damage 2d8 type=fire]]伤害。
2♦ (方片)这张卡牌会发出闪电。目标必须进行一次[[/save ability=dex dc=15]]豁免。豁免失败时目标将陷入 目盲Blinded 状态，持续直至在你的下一个回合结束。此外，若目标豁免失败，目标周围10尺范围内的每个生物都将受到[[/damage 1d6 type=lightning]]伤害。
3♥ (红心)这张卡牌使目标身上附着一层厚厚的冰。目标会立刻受到[[/damage 1d10 type=cold]]伤害，并必须通过一次[[/save ability=con dc=15]]豁免，豁免失败时该生物将被 束缚Restrained 状态，直到你的下一回合结束为止。
4♠ (黑桃)这张卡牌释放出尖锐的、震撼性的爆破。目标及其周围5尺范围内的每个生物都将受到[[/damage 1d6 type=force]]伤害，并必须通过一次[[/save ability=str dc=15]]豁免，豁免失败者将陷入 倒地Prone 状态。

This deck of heavy vellum cards hums with the magic of the Elemental Chaos.

The magic of the deck functions only if cards are drawn at random (a deck of real-world playing cards can simulate the deck). As an action, you can draw a random card from this deck and throw it to make a ranged spell attack, using Dexterity for the attack roll. The card has a range of 30 feet. On a hit, it deals [[/damage 1d4 type=slashing]] damage and imposes a magical effect determined by its suit, as detailed in the Deck of Wild Cards table. The card immediately returns to the deck after it hits or misses a target.

Deck of Wild Cards
[[/r d4]]SuitEffect
1♣ (Rods)The card explodes in a burst of fire. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw or take [[/damage 2d8 type=fire]] damage.
2♦ (Coins)The card shoots streaks of lightning. The target must make a [[/save ability=dex dc=15]] saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the blinded condition until the end of your next turn, and each creature within 10 feet of the target takes [[/damage 1d6 type=lightning]] damage.
3♥ (Cups)The card covers the target in a thick layer of ice. The target takes [[/damage 1d10 type=cold]] damage and must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=15]] saving throw or have the restrained condition until the end of your next turn.
4♠ (Swords)The card unleashes a sharp, concussive blast. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it take [[/damage 1d6 type=force]] damage and must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=15]] saving throw or have the prone condition.
